request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Ana: about thirty, long wavy black hair, an olive-green button shirt open over a white top. Keep her face, hair and clothes exactly. Create a NEW photograph in a bright room: Ana stands on the left half of the photo, smiling, and holds up her smartphone in one hand with its screen turned toward the camera, large in the right half of the photo. The screen is plain white and shows only a small green telephone-handset icon at the top and, below it, one phone number in very large black digits: exactly 555-0142. The digits fill most of the screen width, are perfectly sharp and nothing covers them. There is no name, no letter, no word, no clock and no other number on the screen or anywhere else in the photo. Ana is seen from the waist up; her face and the whole phone are sharp. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
